method: Written-down value: each year's rate applies to the pool's depreciation base

pools.assets: Buildings, structures and similar works of a permanent nature
Computers, data processing equipment, furniture, fixtures and office equipment
Construction and excavation equipment, and depreciable assets not in another pool
Intangible assets other than those in pool D
pools.method: Cost divided by useful life, rounded to the nearest half year; each asset is its own pool

additions_note: The rest of the cost is added to the pool the following year

small_balance.rule: If a pool's balance after the year's depreciation is under NPR 2,000, the whole balance is deducted that year
